## ✨ What's New

- Browse nested specs (such as `network/auth`) in a dedicated Specs panel with a collapsible folder tree, spec counts, validation state, and keyboard navigation
- Make Markdown links work: spec and change links open inside the app, heading anchors scroll, and external links open in a new tab
- Open local files from Markdown links in your editor (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, Antigravity IDE, Zed, or a custom URL template), set in Settings → General. The default copies the path
- Support line fragments such as `#L10`, `#L10-20`, and `#10-20` in file links, and open change files the viewer does not show (for example `evidence/*.txt`) as local files
- Mark links to missing files; clicking one copies the path with a warning instead of opening the editor
- Fix relative links in archived change documents by falling back to the pre-archive location

## 🔧 Maintenance

- Update the tool reference to OpenSpec v2.2.0 (no supported-tool changes)
